read @docs/design/system-architecture.md. Disregard @trace_utils/ folder completely for this session. That is utility and not part of this work. 
We will do a little brainstorm on event msging work.
I will actually lay it out for you. When I am finshed I will ask you to opine and go. undrestood.

We are focusing on small piece that is the event msging infra. Section 5 laysout the shape.
The msgs flow between collector and ingest service. 
7.1 also talks about small handshake that creates a API key when a producer registers for first time. Which is then stored and checked on subsequent msgs.
1. The shape of the JSON/Payload is bound to change but whats in is fine to begin with. 
2. I am thinking the event msg infra can be a simple client lib that can be used by the collector. Simple calls like register(), send(), there may be some variation. Retry mechanism, backoff and other transport related are all part of this small library. 
3. On server side which is ingest at this point. Needs to store the API key. Idelly this is not Ingest responsibilit so the small library should actually handle the API key storage part. The backend is PG but ideally could be anything including Db or simple file/S3 what not. Having a flexibility is good idea. For example in the begining it could be a simple JSON file on configured folder if the backend adapter is file. 
4. The server do send ACK/NACK upon processing, with reasons and error code. Timeout needs to handled as NACK and sent to the producer or whoever is the client.  
5. Where should this little code live. Its not a package but a small common code that is shared intimately between collector/produceer sending events and ingest processing events.

As you see the scope is very small and well defined.

2. Agree on spool or rather a durable storage that makes sure the msg is delivered at least once. In the first case the there is only the whole file, so seq for a given session_id is zero. Does it make sense to use -1 to signify there is no more session. I want to hear your opinion. It is not necessary though. 

the client will create the header once for a given session.
event_id: Think this UUID can be managed by this library. make sure to use well known UUID lib if possible (in case the idea is to use UUID)

3. Key storage. Agree. It needs to store Produce realted record, correctly called. And that will also expand, meaning the payload will expand as we go thru usse cases. But the trasnport will not change. producer_id generated -> poroducer attribute supplied during registration msg the blob taht contains producer attribute can eveolve freely. 

I think we are in agreemenet mostly. 

Make sure to generate doc/readme for this. Where should we put this. I like to keep things in the docs. This is not part of design folder. Perhaps we call this info, code_doc - any suggestion
